name: auryn-sql
summary: Generic relational-database schema ingestor for Auryn: reflects any SQLAlchemy-supported engine (PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQLite, Oracle, ...) into Database/Schema/Table/Column/View/Sequence/Index/Constraint nodes plus foreign-key edges, via SQLAlchemy's dialect-agnostic Inspector. Dialect-specific DBAPI drivers are optional extras, auto-installed on demand.
